natural_body: 40% SMB discount: +31% signups, +18% rev, -12% ret; judge at renewal

first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and is supported by durable activation and time-to-value gains. Promotional pricing could counter the competitor, but the prior 40% discount reduced retention by 12% and still required renewal-stage evaluation, creating material long-term revenue risk. Verify the onboarding evidence and the discount's unresolved downstream economics before committing.
